name: Caslon Initials 1841
designer: Individual engravers unidentified in the specimen
description: Masonry, curled plain and shaded, and flourished blackletter initials from the H. Caslon specimen of 1841.
observed: 88 complete historical designs. Source inventory records distinct engravings, repeated impressions, assembled settings and existing canonical designs. Standalone illustrated letters, not an incomplete text font.
reconstructed: No invented pictorial content. Recorded exclusions remove neighbouring sorts, captions and isolated scan specks. Measured rotation and recorded quadrilateral corrections straighten scan geometry; uniform scaling preserves historical proportions.
